methodology: Measures generate_grounded_answer() end-to-end latency (Cerebras network round trip + local validation/compilation/rendering, all real calls, no mocking) across all 16 real Phase-6 benchmark cases (10 dev + 3 validation + 3 held-out, round-2/frozen results only). Explicitly SEPARATE from and NOT blended with: Phase-4 retrieval latency, Phase-5 Evidence-normalization latency, or any other network-source latency - those are not part of this measurement at all (this benchmark's Evidence[] was pre-built from already-captured raw records, not freshly retrieved).
caveat_rate_limit_dominated: Cerebras Free Trial tier is 5 RPM (capacity=1, no burst) - the SAME rate-limit bucket used by Phase 2's frozen NLU path. Most of the ~12s per-call wall time below is the rate-limiter's enforced wait, not actual model inference time (mirrors the exact same measurement caveat documented in artifacts/v2/nlu_frozen_config.json for the Phase-2 Cerebras candidate) - this is NOT a claim about true model latency.

cost.pricing_source: artifacts/v2/phase5_frozen_config.json's pricing_per_million_tokens_usd (same frozen Cerebras qwen-3.8-27b model/account)

explicit_non_claims: This does not measure or improve retrieval latency.
This does not measure or improve Evidence-normalization latency.
Zero-Evidence cases (2 of 16) made 0 LLM calls by design and are included in the per-case latency distribution at their true near-zero cost, not excluded.
